name: Intravesical BCG - maintenance (3 weekly instillations per block)
cyclesNote: Maintenance is delivered as short blocks of 3 weekly instillations (encoded here as a 7-day cycle x 3 = one block). The SWOG schedule repeats a 3-weekly block at 3, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, and 36 months for 1-3 years in BCG-responsive high-risk NMIBC.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Maintenance intravesical BCG in patients responsive to induction improves recurrence-free and progression-free outcomes over induction alone. No molecular biomarker gates its use.

supportiveCare: Same pre-instillation safety checks as induction: no active UTI, gross hematuria, traumatic catheterization, or febrile illness.
Retain about 2 hours with position changes; disinfect voided urine for 6 hours.
Dose reduction (one-third to one-tenth vial) is a common way to improve tolerability during maintenance without losing efficacy.
monitoring: cystoscopy + cytology at scheduled surveillance visits
periodic upper-tract imaging for high-risk disease

doseModificationRules.condition: cumulative local intolerance across maintenance blocks
doseModificationRules.text: Reduce the instilled BCG dose (e.g. to one-third vial) or lengthen intervals for recurrent grade >= 2 cystitis; discontinue for systemic reaction and evaluate for BCG infection. Physician decides.

drugs.name: BCG (intravesical)
drugs.notes: One reconstituted vial (or a reduced fraction for tolerability) instilled weekly x3 per maintenance block, blocks repeating on the SWOG calendar (3, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36 months). Strain-defined vial as in induction (TICE approximately 50 mg, Connaught approximately 81 mg); strains are not interchangeable. Own wording; standard reference dose.

provenance.locator: Principles of Intravesical Therapy - BCG maintenance (SWOG 3-weekly blocks)
